program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    month_code = dt.month
    day_width = len(day)
    sp1_len = len(sp1)
    sp2_len = len(sp2)
    packed = month_code * 1000000 + dt.day * 10000 + dt.hour * 100 + dt.minute
    return {'stored': [packed], 'layout': [sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width]}

def inverse(record):
    packed = int(record['stored'][0])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width = record['layout']
    month_code = packed // 1000000
    day = (packed // 10000) % 100
    hour = (packed // 100) % 100
    minute = packed % 100
    dt = datetime(1900, month_code, day, hour, minute)
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    day_text = str(day).zfill(day_width)
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    return month + (' ' * sp1_len) + day_text + (' ' * sp2_len) + time
